name: IESO 2026 Annual Planning Outlook
known_limitations: The report is a scenario-based provincial forecast with corrected supplementary tables. Its reference case does not prove a specific distribution connection, local transformer or feeder capacity, project service timing, or future demand realization.
automation_notes: Track annual forecast revisions, corrected tables, procurements, transmission plans, distribution filings, and project-specific service records.
notes: Published March 20, 2026. IESO's summary reports 65% long-term demand growth and data centres reaching 8.6% of Ontario demand in 2050 in the reference scenario.
